title: Redraw Courtesy on Genetic Self-Pay Quotes
content:
A Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class whose specimen has been rejected receives a redraw courtesy on its genetic self-pay quote. The courtesy depends on the reasons recorded on the accession's specimen rejections.

- When **any** specimen rejection on the accession carries the reason *stability exceeded* or *leaked in transit*, the quote is reduced by **10 percent** of the test price sum as a redraw courtesy.
- When the accession carries rejections and none of them has either of those two reasons, the quote is reduced by **5 percent** of the test price sum.
- An accession with no rejection takes no redraw courtesy.

| Rejections recorded on the accession | Quote reduced by |
|---|---|
| At least one with stability exceeded or leaked in transit | 10 percent of the test price sum |
| One or more, none with either of those reasons (for example hemolyzed, quantity not sufficient, unlabeled or mislabeled, wrong container) | 5 percent of the test price sum |
| None | nothing |

**Cases (hypothetical, test price sum of 400.00).**

1. Rejected once for hemolysis: the quote is reduced by 20.00.
2. Rejected for leakage in transit and later for hemolysis: one rejection has a transport reason, whichever came last, so the quote is reduced by 40.00.
3. Never rejected: no redraw courtesy.
